steps.say: The scan shows a wide opening about 3.5 m long centred on 90° (my left), with walls much closer on either side. I'll turn left to face it.
The scan shows open space straight ahead (about 3.5 m at 350 to 10 degrees), with the narrowest nearby reading at 1.21 m, so I'll drive forward 1 m.
The scan shows open space straight ahead, with obstacles about 0.7 m away on both front edges. The gap is roughly 0.6 m wide, which is enough for my 0.34 m body, so I'll drive forward 0.5 m.
The front arc (330 to 30 degrees) clears about 1.6 m at its narrowest, so I'll drive forward 1 m and rescan.
The room opens to the south and west, while a wall about 0.6 m to my west blocks that side here. I'll turn to face south, back toward the open area near my start.
The opening is ahead and to the front-right, while an obstacle sits at about 0.5 m on my front-left. I'll turn right about 25° to line up with the opening before driving.

The open space is straight ahead and slightly left, with a wall close on my right at about 25°. I'll turn 10° left to centre on the clear arc before driving.
The forward arc is blocked at about 0.54 m on my front-left (15°), so I'll turn 20° right to clear it before driving.
The forward arc opens about 3.4 m straight ahead, but walls sit about 0.6 m off at roughly ±35°, so the corridor is tight. I'll creep forward 0.3 m and rescan before committing.

The front arc is open for about 3 m, but the right-front wall is about 0.33 m off and the left-front wall about 0.33 m off, so the passage is tight. I'll creep forward 0.5 m straight ahead and rescan.
The forward arc is open for about 2.6 m, but the right-front edge is about 0.8 m away, so I'll creep forward 0.5 m and rescan.
The forward arc is open for about 2.2 m, and the nearest reading in the 330 to 30 arc is 0.71 m on the right-front edge. I'll drive forward 1 m and rescan.
The open space is behind me (rays 170 to 190 read about 3.3 m), while the right side is walled in close, so I'll turn around to face that way.
The forward arc (0 to 10 degrees) reads about 3.3 m, with walls close on both sides, so I'll drive forward 1 m and rescan.
The forward arc is clear for about 2.3 m straight ahead, and the nearest side reading (0.43 m at 30°) gives enough lateral clearance. I'll drive 1 m forward and rescan.
The rear arc (170 to 210 degrees) is open for about 3 m, while the front is walled at about 1.3 m. I'll back up 1.5 m to get into the open area behind me and rescan.
The last move was clamped to -1.0 m, so I'm back at the spot from step 15. The open space is behind me (about 2.1 m) and the front-left wall is close, so I'll turn to face the open rear and rescan.

Ahead of me the arc reads about 2.2 m, and the closest point on my right-front (330°) is 0.68 m, which gives roughly 0.34 m lateral clearance. That's enough for a 1 m straight move, so I'll drive forward and rescan.
The scan shows a long opening about 60° to my right (rays 295 to 300 read about 3.9 m), with a wall close on my right side. I'll turn to face it and check the scan.
The front-right is walled at about 0.2 m, so driving straight would clip it. The left-front is more open, so I'll turn left about 15° to clear the right wall before driving.
I'm boxed in on most sides, but rays 220 to 235 (left-rear) read about 3.3 m through a gap about 1.2 m wide. I'll turn left about 135° to face that opening.
The open space is about 3.3 m away at 80 to 100 degrees, to my left. I'll turn to face it.
The forward arc is clear for about 3 m, with the nearest reading 1.12 m at 30°, so a 0.5 m move is safe. I'll advance and rescan.
The forward arc is clear for about 2.8 m straight ahead; the closest reading is 0.86 m at 20°, which is enough clearance for a 0.5 m move. I'll advance and rescan.
The front arc is clear for about 2.3 m, and the nearest reading on the front-right edge (330°) is 0.61 m, which leaves room for the body. I'll drive forward 1 m and rescan.
The rear arc reads about 3.1 m clear, and that direction is open from the start too, so I'll turn to face it and head that way.
The scan shows a clear corridor ahead, but walls sit about 0.25 m to my front-left and 0.4 m to my front-right. Turning about 20° left should line me up with the middle of that gap.
The scan shows about 3 m of clear space straight ahead, but the left-front wall is very close at 30° (0.27 m). I'll turn 10° right to add clearance before driving.
The forward arc (330 to 30 degrees) is clear, with the nearest reading about 1.35 m, so I'll drive forward 1 m and rescan.
The forward arc (330 to 30) is clear for about 2.1 m, so I'll drive forward 1 m and rescan.
The open gap is about 75° to my right (rays 280 to 290 read about 4.2 m), with walls close on the left. I'll turn to face it.
